rho_reference.strongest_available_basis: Both 28-bit curves are prime-order curves over prime fields (p and r prime, r = p + 1 - t, cofactor 1) with j not 0 or 1728 (j recomputed from a, b solved on G and the targets, equal to the ICV1 j), so Aut(E) = {+1, -1}: negation is the only automorphism fold, there is no subfield Frobenius fold over F_p, and the Frobenius discriminants (squarefree parts -69430827 and -598737787) give no small-norm endomorphism. Records show automorphisms_used 2.

rho_reference.order_note: rho-neg < dgb (= dg) at w = 0, 0.1 and 1 on both curves; distance remaining dgb/rho-neg 21.79, 20.66, 15.48 (pooled). The improvement this file admits is wall-clock (ns per charged GAE), not a counted ranking: counted S of dgb and dg are identical.

caveats: 28 bits: wall-clock improvement of the packed-table oracle at N_inc 407: corrected dgb/dg ns per GAE 0.929953 [0.926605, 0.933313] (288 L2 pairs, both A/A admitted). It is a component speed-up of the oracle (whole-solve wall per charged GAE), outside tables A-C; counted S is identical record by record, so no counted ranking and no distance to rho changes (dg/rho-neg = dgb/rho-neg = 21.79, 20.66, 15.48 at w = 0, 0.1, 1).

Per-curve corrected ratios at 28 bits differ beyond their intervals: icv1-fp28-t9805-a382b8a8 0.9379 [0.9333, 0.9425], icv1-fp28-tm3463-6d2f5699 0.9212 [0.9168, 0.9257]. Both are below 1; the size of the gain depends on the curve.

Target-clustered intervals (48 targets) are a little wider than the pair interval and stay below 1: linearised joint [0.92610, 0.93382], independent combination [0.92597, 0.93396], stratified bootstrap [0.92703, 0.93276].

ns per GAE is an upper bound per operation for both arms alike (unpriced native work: sqrt solves, lookups, row ops, Legendre symbols, target-guard probes). Measured on EKS c8a.2xlarge (AMD EPYC 9R45) only; wall time is not replayable, counted scalars are (6,912 of 6,912 replays identical on an Intel host).
Packed layout only (RULING-P2 A1): p <= 2^32-1 and at most 2^16 signed points. The small-maps branch of the same oracle string is untested.
